Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Emma Johnson's Trip: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES
(For Waikiki Beach, Hanauma Bay Snorkeling, Kailua Beach Kayaking)
  - Swimwear (at least 2-3 swimsuits)
  - Beach cover-ups
  - Beach towels
  - Snorkeling gear (or rent on-site)
  - Water shoes
  - Sunscreen (reef-safe, SPF 50+)
  - After-sun lotion/aloe vera
  - Beach bag
  - Waterproof phone case
  - Sunglasses (with UV protection)
  - Wide-brimmed hat or cap

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES
(For Diamond Head Hike, North Shore Road Trip)
  - Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers
  - Hiking gear (backpack, water bottle)
  - Moisture-wicking athletic wear
  - Light jacket or windbreaker
  - Insect repellent
  - First aid kit
  - Reusable water bottle

CASUAL WEAR & EVENING ATTIRE
(For Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center, Shopping at Ala Moana Center)
  - Casual outfits (shorts, t-shirts, sundresses)
  - Light pants or jeans
  - Comfortable walking shoes
  - Sandals or flip-flops
  - Luau-appropriate outfit (tropical shirt, dress, or nice casual)
  - Light sweater or cardigan for air-conditioned spaces

RELAXATION & SPA DAY
(For Hotel Spa Day - June 17)
  - Comfortable loungewear
  - Slippers
  - Robe (if not provided by hotel)

SIGHTSEEING
(For Pearl Harbor Visit)
  - Comfortable walking shoes
  - Respectful attire (no swimwear)
  - Small backpack or day bag

ELECTRONICS & DOCUMENTS
  - Camera with extra batteries/charger
  - Smartphone and charger
  - Portable power bank
  - Travel adapters (if needed)
  - Travel documents (ID, passport, boarding passes)
  - Hotel reservations and confirmations
  - Travel insurance documents
  - Credit cards and cash

TOILETRIES & PERSONAL ITEMS
  - Toothbrush and toothpaste
  - Shampoo and conditioner
  - Body wash
  - Deodorant
  - Razor and shaving cream
  - Hairbrush/comb
  - Hair styling products
  - Makeup and makeup remover
  - Medications and prescriptions
  - Contact lenses and solution (if needed)
  - Feminine hygiene products

MISCELLANEOUS
  - Travel pillow
  - Earplugs and eye mask
  - Books or e-reader
  - Travel journal and pen
  - Reusable shopping bags
  - Zip-lock bags (for wet swimwear)
  - Laundry bag
  - Snacks for travel days

NOTES:
  - Check weather forecast closer to departure date
  - Most hotels provide basic toiletries
  - Reef-safe sunscreen is required by law in Hawaii
  - Pearl Harbor has security restrictions on bags
